Data

DataTable

Rounded, card-surface table for schedules, unit lists, fees and program comparisons. Horizontally scrollable on narrow screens.

Live example

The example needs JavaScript; the usage below shows the markup.

Usage

DataTable

Schedules, turmas, unit listings, fee tables. Card-surface with a sunken header row — matches Card radius so tables sit naturally on the cream page.

<DataTable
  caption="Turmas 2026"
  columns={[{key:'programa',label:'Programa'},{key:'turno',label:'Turno'},{key:'status',label:'Status',align:'right'}]}
  rows={[{programa:'Ensino Médio', turno:'Manhã', status:<Badge tone="success">Vagas abertas</Badge>}]}
/>
  • First column renders semibold as the row label — put the identifying value there.
  • Cell values accept nodes: use Badge for status, Tag for program family.
  • Use compact only for 10+ rows; default density suits the brand unhurried rhythm.

Plain HTML contract

Use .rse-data-table, adding --zebra and/or --compact to the root for those variants. The root ref and native attributes target the outer div. The focusable scroller lets keyboard users scroll wide tables. No JavaScript is required. Column width is optional geometry supplied through --rse-data-table-column-width on the header cell; alignment uses __cell--left, __cell--center, or __cell--right on both header and body cells.

<div class="rse-data-table rse-data-table--zebra">
  <div class="rse-data-table__scroller" tabindex="0" role="region" aria-label="Turmas de exemplo">
    <table class="rse-data-table__table">
      <caption class="rse-data-table__caption">Turmas de exemplo</caption>
      <thead><tr><th class="rse-data-table__cell" scope="col">Programa</th><th class="rse-data-table__cell rse-data-table__cell--right" scope="col">Turno</th></tr></thead>
      <tbody><tr><td class="rse-data-table__cell">Ensino médio</td><td class="rse-data-table__cell rse-data-table__cell--right">Manhã</td></tr></tbody>
    </table>
  </div>
</div>

For empty results, render a single td.rse-data-table__empty with colspan equal to the column count and the message Nenhum resultado.. Captions and headers stay in sentence case.

Props

PropTypeRequiredNotes
columnsDataTableColumn[]yes
rowsRecord<string, React.ReactNode>[]yesRow objects keyed by column key; values may be nodes (Tags, Badges, links)
captionstring—Optional eyebrow caption above the table
zebraboolean—Alternate row tint (default true)
compactboolean—Tighter row height for dense schedules
emptyMessagestring—

Also accepts every attribute of React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, a ref and className.
